description: Change a maintenance window that has not finished, or end one in progress now with endNow. Its start is fixed once it has begun. Owners and Admins only. Titles and messages are what customers read: no internal names, repositories, people or other customers. Text the disclosure check stops is refused with disclosure_hits_remaining and the hits; reword it. Acts as you, with the same checks as the Console; a service account's key is refused. Requires `write` scope.

accountIds.description: Customer account ids; required with audience accounts.

audience.description: public: the public page and every customer link. accounts: only the links of accountIds.

endNow.description: End a window in progress at this moment. Not with endsAt.

endsAt.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 string with a time zone (2026-11-20T02:00:00Z).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifRevision.description: The revision you read. A stale one is refused (publication_modified / maintenance_modified); read again and retry.

maintenanceId.description: The maintenance window id from anyforge_list_status_page_maintenance.

startsAt.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 string with a time zone (2026-11-20T02:00:00Z).

title.description: One line customers read (at most 120 characters). Not the internal title or cause.

name: anyforge_update_status_page_maintenance
title: Update status page maintenance
